IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives McIntire, Orcutt, Conway, Hunter, Chase and Santos

Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying municipal business and occupation taxation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the allocation of printing and publishing incomefor municipal business and occupation taxes; adding a new section tochapter 35.102 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.102 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Notwithstanding RCW 35.102.130, a city that imposes a business andoccupation tax shall allocate a person's gross income from theactivities of printing, and of publishing newspapers, periodicals, ormagazines, to the commercial domicile of the taxpayer. As used in thissection, the activities of printing, and of publishing newspapers,periodicals, or magazines, have the same meanings as attributed tothose terms in RCW 82.04.280(1) by the department of revenue.
